<!-- Generated by tools/build_courses.py: edit the COURSES config there. -->

Find structure in data without labels: clustering with K-Means and DBSCAN, dimensionality reduction with PCA, then text: NLP basics and topic modeling, and two projects. Each section has **lessons**, a **quiz**, **exercises** and their **solutions**.

Each section has a zip with the lessons, the exercises and the data, so you can run everything on your computer (Python 3 with Jupyter, or [Anaconda](https://www.anaconda.com/download)). Solutions stay on this site.

## Clustering

1. **K-Means**: Group similar observations: the K-Means algorithm step by step, then choosing the number of clusters. [Lessons](01-kmeans/lessons/kmeans.ipynb) · [Quiz](01-kmeans/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](01-kmeans/exercises/know-your-customers.ipynb) · [Solutions](01-kmeans/solutions/know-your-customers.ipynb)
2. **DBSCAN**: Density-based clustering: clusters of any shape, and noise points. [Lessons](02-dbscan/lessons/dbscan.ipynb) · [Quiz](02-dbscan/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](02-dbscan/exercises/911-emergencies.ipynb) · [Solutions](02-dbscan/solutions/911-emergencies.ipynb)

## Dimensionality reduction

3. **Principal component analysis**: Reduce the number of variables while keeping most of the information. [Lessons](03-pca/lessons/pca.ipynb) · [Quiz](03-pca/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](03-pca/exercises/house-prices.ipynb) · [Solutions](03-pca/solutions/house-prices.ipynb)

## Text

4. **Natural language processing**: Turn texts into numbers: cleaning, tokens, lemmas, bag of words and TF-IDF. [Lessons](04-nlp/lessons/nlp-basics.ipynb) · [Quiz](04-nlp/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](04-nlp/exercises/obi-wan-kenobi.ipynb) · [Solutions](04-nlp/solutions/obi-wan-kenobi.ipynb)
5. **Topic modeling**: Find the hidden topics of a collection of texts with latent semantic analysis (LSA). [Lessons](05-topic-modeling/lessons/lsa.ipynb) · [Quiz](05-topic-modeling/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](05-topic-modeling/exercises/topic-modeling.ipynb) · [Solutions](05-topic-modeling/solutions/topic-modeling.ipynb)

## Projects

6. **Project: Uber pickups**: Find the hot zones of New York for each day and hour with K-Means and DBSCAN. [Lesson](06-uber-pickups/lessons/uber-pickups.ipynb) · [Solution](06-uber-pickups/solutions/uber-pickups.ipynb)
7. **Project: an outdoor shop catalogue**: Group products by their descriptions, build a recommender, and find the topics of a catalogue. [Lesson](07-outdoor-catalog/lessons/outdoor-catalog.ipynb) · [Solution](07-outdoor-catalog/solutions/outdoor-catalog.ipynb)
